[[Shaan]] is an [[Asura]] collector, a type of NPC that exchanges [[trophy|trophies]] for weapons.

==Locations==
*[[Tarnished Coast]]
**{{NPC location|Riven Earth}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Ew! I mean...uh...rawr! Not very convincing, hm? I knew it. I'm a great hunter, but when it comes to bugs...I just can't do it! I can hunt the great lizards, the monsters of the deep, even the fiercest mountain cat, but spiders? Ew! Hey, maybe you can help. If you bring me 5 [[Weaver Leg]]s, I can redeem my name! I'll trade you the fruit of my labors in return."''
